name: paranoidal-CodexRPG
author: ProjectMakers, FactorioParanoidal
title: Paranoidal Codex RPG
description: RPG system and base journal of the Paranoidal modpack. Experience, levels and skills from PM RPG System by ProjectMakers (based on MFerrari's RPGsystem), plus a full-screen journal: base passport, statistics of the base, world, war and quality, milestones, a short codex and BnL Premium: the Gold Card holders who support the modpack and the features made at their request (the codex with the statistics, a calendar and an alarm clock). Formerly PMRPGsystem: progress from old saves is taken over automatically.
